svg.title: Launch geometry: beam spot offset and tilt
svg.desc: (a) Fiber end face with cladding, core of radius a and the VCSEL beam spot of radius w, shifted from the core center by the offset delta x. (b) Side view: the beam hits the end face at offset delta x and tilted by the angle theta against the fiber axis.
